conditions.outcomes: Identical to previous code-masked architecture: peer prompt/outcome/error/history remain; full peer code masked; diagnosis always private.
conditions.none: Latest peer evidence is []; ledger contains current-framework rows only. No peer task prompts, code, outcomes, errors, acceptance or historical events reach the LLM. Own code, outcomes and diagnoses remain subject to the original restart masking.

registry.fixed: Original policies, JSON schema, own history handling, restart threshold and algorithm, model, common initial126, max5 repairs, round-robin orchestration and workers.
registry.note: Static policy still mentions SDK names and generic peer use, but no task-specific peer data is supplied. Source prompt and internal accepted_peers metadata are kept on disk for audit only and are not passed to the tool-disabled LLM.
registry.stopping_rule: Complete all four full126 trajectories, regardless of interim scores. No result-dependent tuning or extra repetitions.
registry.primary: Mean final acceptance difference outcomes-minus-none across two repetitions. Report each repetition and discordant cases.
registry.analysis: Average paired differences over three SDKs and two repetitions within each of42 families; percentile95 cluster bootstrap20000 draws, seed2026091602. Intervals do not capture all model-generation variability.
registry.interpretation: Both repetition differences must be positive and bootstrap95 lower bound above0 to call a consistent benefit of remaining peer information. Otherwise report point estimate and uncertainty; no equivalence claim from a tie.
registry.recovery: Preserve completed raw transport-fallback responses without resampling. For an exact empty capacity failure with no answer, usage, reasoning or tool events, allow at most one identical prompt/model/schema retry per candidate slot, archive all failed raw bytes and report failed backend invocations separately. Surface all other errors.
